item.title: Keeping pkgsrc packages up to date
item.author: julio@meroh.net (Julio Merino)
item.description: drio asks in the suggestion box which is the best way to keep all the packages installed from pkgsrc up to date. I must confess that pkgsrc is quite weak in the updating area when compared to systems such as apt-get or yum. The problem comes from the fact that pkgsrc is a source-based packaging system, meaning that the end user builds packages by himself most of the times. Doing updates from such a system is hard because rebuilds take a long time and have high chances of breaking, leaving your system in an unusable status. Of course there is support for binary packages in pkgsrc, but we are not doing a good job in providing good sets of prebuilt binaries. Furthermore, and as drio stated, there is few documentation on the subject.
